equity.level_reason: Units are countries grouped by WHO region and year; no social-position dimension is defined, compared or discussed.
equity.equity_measurement: Comparisons are by WHO region and year only (geography, not an SPD); nonreporting countries are counted as not meeting the indicator.

notes: Design inferred as monitoring progress against the WHO indicator; none is named. Countries not reporting to VigiBase or the Joint Reporting Form stay in denominators as not meeting the measures. Percent changes (eightfold, 21% decline) are arithmetic, not procedures.
view_issues: Table CSV repeats the WPR and All regions rows with identical values for the two denominators (2020–2021 vs 2022). The prepass diagnostic-accuracy cue ('system sensitivity') is a false hit.
